scope: Bounded AC1021 DXF minimal MATERIAL record with terminal group-94 channel flags.

source.provenance: Existing libdxfrw test fixture, not an independent producer drawing.
source.independentReader: ezdxf 1.4.5 reads both fixture MATERIAL records with channel flags 7.

finding: The prior reader rejected these records at group 94 because no full map tuple preceded it, blocking the fixture and its raw control-group callbacks.
change: Admit only AC1021 records with one nonzero self handle, one nonzero owner, one AcDbMaterial subclass, one name and otherwise only balanced application groups before a terminal group 94. Publish the known channel value and exact raw group carrier. A nonterminal tail is rejected before material publication. Mark the partial record raw-only so both typed encoders refuse it; no new virtual or class member was added.
checks: Existing repository fixture now imports both typed MATERIAL callbacks, two dictionaries and an XRECORD; raw nested control groups and channel flag are retained.
Locally generated AC1021 ASCII/Binary cases reject an appended field without publishing the material, then succeed when corrected on the same reader.

Typed DXF ASCII/Binary writer refusal preserves the destination and caller state; typed DWG AC1018/AC1027 encoding refuses without changing its buffer. dwg2dxf import reaches output preflight, which still refuses the unqualified MATERIAL graph.
Six focused CTests pass, including existing MATERIAL source-order/color/compact graph and APPID/VPORT allocation controls. The focused sparse control also passes in a clean AddressSanitizer build.
Two other material tests, normal-boundaries and sparse-material-raw, failed identically against a baseline library rebuilt from HEAD before this reader change; they remain open.
The aggregate DXF fixture executable remains red with 16 assertions, mostly VIEWPORT/VisualStyle plus SORTENTSTABLE, proxy and table-border cases. No source drawing fixtures were added or changed.
The implementation digest was refreshed from a clean index matching 5992 staged tracked entries; support statuses and evidence links were not promoted.
limits: This is a narrow reader/callback profile, not general sparse-material acceptance, graph closure, typed output, interoperability, or native rendering qualification.
The newly registered fast tests require a refreshed frozen CTest inventory before hosted native qualification can run.
